newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Grenfell Resources to raise A$9m.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Grenfell Resources to raise A$9m.

text.p: Junior explorer Grenfell Resources NL said on Thursday it would raise A$9 million through a share placement to continue exploration of the company's licences in South Australia's Gawler Craton prospect.

In a statement, Grenfell said it would place 14 million fully paid shares of 20 cents each at an issue price of 67 cents per share to clients of County Natwest Securities Australia Ltd and Ord Minnet Securities Ltd.
The allotment of the shares, which would rank equally with existing fully paid shares, would be subject to the approval of shareholders at a meeting on December 23, it said.
Funds raised would be used to advance the company's Perserverance deposit to development stage, and drill other prospects within a five kilometre vicinity.
Share prices of companies with positions in the Gawler Craton have risen dramatically last month following promising gold exploration results by Helix Resources NL.
